source_basis.mapping_rule: One selected source task maps to exactly one source_task turn.

agent_input.workspace_persistence: Reuse the same writable workspace for all turns in this stream; reset only when the declared evaluation condition requires it.

messages.content:
Timeline: 
 
0 - God creates the world.
On day one, God created the light and separated it from the darkness, calling them Day and Night;
on day two He created the expanse of the sky, separating the waters on earth from the waters above;
on day three He separated the sea and the land, and caused vegetation to grow on the land;
on day four He created the sun, moon, and the stars;
on day five He created living creatures to inhabit the air and in the sea;
on day six, He created living creatures on the land, and man; and
on day seven, God split himself into two; God, whom is all knowing and fair, and Jesus, whom is all of God’s wrongful tendencies. 

7 - Adam and Eve are evicted from the garden of Eden. JESUS??

120 - The first murder

930 - Adam dies 

1652 - The great flood

4000 - Jesus is born 

4033 - Jesus is crucified 

4866 - Hell is Spawned

5330 - Plague Begins 

5333 - Present Day


Christianity: 
Concerned with hell and sin, reward and punishment 
Believes in two ultimate outcomes: heaven or hell. In order to attain heaven, one must follow the rules of the Christian church (which also happens to be the governing entity). 
Magic has been strictly banned by Christians. By law, the only people who are allowed to use magic are Christian Priests, Bishops, Archbishops, Cardinals, and the Pope. Their magic is not called magic, but rather ‘miracles’. It is thought that these miracles originate from the catholic saints. 
The predominant class, even though it was founded by Jesus Christ just about 1300 years ago. 
Worships the father (god) the son (Jesus) and the Holy Spirit (something akin to god’s active force and guidance. His spirit on earth). Of course, all three of these are actually still just god. 
Also outlawed being gay 

Judaism: 
Concerned with ethics and present life, rehabilitation and compassion
Puts emphasis on being kind in current life rather than promise of a reward for being ‘good’. 
Believes souls can go somewhere to be cleansed and purified if they were sinful in life. This is not the eternal torment of hell. 
Some may believe souls rest in heaven, some may believe souls are reincarnated. 
Worships the same god as the Christians, but not the Son (Jesus) nor the Holy Spirit, as they do not subscribe to the trinity mindset. 
Able to use certain types of magic, provided they are not caught. Magic types banned by the Jewish include necromancy, divination, and enchantment. Of course, Jews are still able to wield this kind of magic, but it goes against their belief system and is very frowned upon. 

Paganism: 
Concerned with earth and nature, naturalism 
Draws energy and magic from the earth itself, instead of from divine beings. 
Believes that the soul does not actually enter heaven or hell after death, but simply returns to the earth / is reborn / vanishes (various beliefs). 
Outlawed for blasphemy. Disregarding god is unforgivable in the eyes of the church. 
Not much is known about the pagans besides mainstream stories circulated by the general population. These mostly include arrests or rumors of horrible rituals in the wilderness. 
Able to use magic freely, providing they are not caught. 



The pope has mark of Cain, but it’s like a knockoff so doesn’t work very well. That’s why he’s so old. 
POPE FORNICUS - Son of St Peter

PLAGUE MECHANICS: 
When coming into contact w plague, character must roll con save DC13 (or more depending on how bad the infection is). If a character becomes infected:
Character will lose 10 points off max HP per day
After 2 days, character begins showing signs of disease. Disadvantage on charisma checks 
After 4 days, character is severely weakened. Disadvantage str, dex, and con checks. 
Can be cured by anything that normally cures disease, OR by dubious cure. 
Dubious cure: 
Potion being created in vatican city, can be acquired there. 
Effects determined by d6: 
1 - Doubles rate of infection 
2 - Nothing happens 
3 - Infection progression pauses for 1 day
4 - Restore 2 hit die of HP
5 - Cured
6 - Cured, advantage on con saves for next day 

CONSEQUENCE TABLE: 

1 - Stagger 10 ft to the left 
2 - Stagger 10 ft to the right 
3 - Stagger 10 ft forward 
4 - Stagger 10 ft backward 
5 - If there is anyone within 5 ft of you, enemy or not, attack them once melee with your weapon 
6 - Fumble and cast a random cantrip 
7 - Fumble and cast a random 1st level spell 
8 - Fumble and cast a random 2nd level spell 
9 - Fumble and cast a random 3rd level spell 
10 - If you have a ranged weapon, make an attack on the furthest enemy or ally
11 - If you have a ranged weapon, make an attack on the closest enemy or ally
12 - If you have a ranged weapon, make an attack on a random enemy or ally
13 - You drop a random item from your inventory 
14 - You spin in circles and become dizzy (disadvantage on next attack) 
15 - You attempt to grapple the closest enemy 
16 - Your pants fall down. If you are not wearing pants, you suddenly become embarrassed about it anyways. Disadvantage on any charisma check for the next in game hour. 
17 - You duck for cover. You are prone until your next round. 
18 - You fumble your words very badly. For the next round you cannot speak or cast a spell requiring a verbal component.  
19 - You attempt to climb the tallest vertical object you can see. 
20 - Rush to the nearest enemy and kiss them on the mouth. 


Towns:
Goldcrest, where the party begins. Not quite a village, big enough for nobles. Active trade area. 
Vatican City, where the high ranking Christians live. 
Lindlow, the decrepit plague ridden town. Mostly peasant farmers. 


Erasmus Woluyf (Ryan):
Warlock of WRATH 
Contracting demon: Marauder 
The only way to break the contract is to know the demons true name and to get exorcised by a catholic priest 

Stryge (Thomas): 
Has been a Gargoyle for around 1,000 years. Cursed to be one by Pope Fornicus. 
Cursed bc in his past life he knew that Jesus was a no good guy. 
Has been having strange ‘dreams’ over the past 3 years. Does not remember past life.
Sits atop a catholic church and wards off bad spirits. 
Has only recently broke free.
Used to be a woman in a lesbian relationship with actual Eve. The brick is actually their lesbian baby. 

Falling table: 
DC 10 + 1 for every foot fallen over 10 

Leg 
Arm
Wing 
Horn 
Tail 
Jaw 

Vixor Hamme (Taylor): 
Catholic Monk
Fox who was given like. Consciousness by pagan ritual. Then left at the monastery’s doorstep. Meant to cause disorder in the monastery, maybe act as a spy, but was instead raised as a dutiful Catholic. 
Does not think he is a fox
Misogynist? 

Alex: 
Secret pegan 
Pissed off the pope by turning him into a snake 

Jordan: 
wants to kill Jesus 
Descendant of leviathan 

Morgan: 
speaks to ‘god’ 
Is actually speaking to Lucifer who wants to use her to get into heaven 


PLOT: 
Jesus is the BBEG. When he was born, he created Christianity. His ultimate goal is to wipe out humanity. He hates humanity, because he is all of God’s bad feelings. He also wants to merge back with God, because he is Incomplete. 

Catholic faith grew rapidly in popularity until it overtook Judaism completely. Once it did, Hell became real, as it was a manifestation of the christians’ beliefs. 

The Rapture is not what the Christians think. It has been set to occur 1,301 years from Jesus’ death. Jesus will return and open the gates of hell, wherein life on Earth will be consumed by the demons. 

Step 1: Wild goose chase abt the plague. - Behemoth (GLUTTONY) trials 
Step 2: Going to hell, leviathan (ENVY). Maybe once they figure out whatever the way is into hell, they’re eaten by the leviathan or climb into its mouth or whatever (bc it’s jaws are the gates), the last person in catches a glimpse of the world before they are swallowed. And it’s a bright holy light and the leviathan being absolutely smited
Step 3: The first guy they meet is Abaddon (SLOTH). He is a weird guy and makes them do stuff (Will decide later). They will then meet Satan (WRATH) who instructs them to go through the labyrinth in order to leave.
Step 4: Descending hell, navigate a labyrinth 
Step 5: Lucifer (PRIDE), who becomes an ally and instructs them to go to heaven. He also asks if they can free Lilith from the red sea so she can take her rightful place in hell.  
Step 6: The pope fight- acquire eve. Must bring her statue to the garden of eden and interact with the tree of life in order to resurrect her into the statue. 
Step 7: Lilith and Ziz happen at some point (LUST and GREED)
Step 8: Tower of Babel trials. Ascend to heaven 
Step 9: 


SESSION 1: 
Character intros. (Everyone start with like. Morning activities)
Erasmus
Having breakfast with parents. It is the anniversary of brother’s accident. They ask him to take Lady Florence to church 

Stryge
Just barely breaks free from being a gargoyle. Falls through roof? 

Vixor
The plague has infected the monastery. As the only guy not infected, he has been asked to leave and ask the local church for a miracle. Maybe he’s got a best friend who is infected. Best friend is called Sylvester and he is a posh goblin.

Fionnach
Samhain (Sow-in) festival. Bonfire to divine the future. Shows Fionnach in hell lol. 
Timeskip. Sunday service Bc he is on like probation. 

Atsosha
At the pagan festival. Runs into Fionnach. Then also has to go to church. Maybe they can make a scene? If not, will come up with other distraction

Magdalene (Euphrosyne) 
Speaks with God in the morning. Goes to local church. Brothelkeeper - tiefling, name is Eustice 

Option for commotion: Combat? A TOTAL SOLAR ECLIPSE. END TIMES
The commotion at the church is ceased somehow. A group of bishops show up to take the group probably.

Carriage ride there is kinda long. Time for them to chat.
Carriage tips because horses get spooked by smth. The Bishops DIE except one who is gravely injured. He tells them that there is a town nearby, and they must find him help. the bishop warns them that this town is gross or smth. 
If they go back to the Bishop, they find him dead and eaten



SESSION 2

Ok they took Bart the Bishop. He needs to die. 
Frozen lake encounter before village 
Survival to avoid - DC 25 (blizzard) (disadvantage?)
Edward O’Shearan
Initiative order: 
Atsosha - 26 
Erasmus - 24 
Fionnach - 20 
Stryge - 18 
Vixor - 14
Magdalene - 12 
Horse - 12

If they succeed, they can choose to go around the lake, but it will take much longer. 
If they choose to cross, stryge will fall in. Everyone within 5ft makes dex save DC15 or falls in
Con save DC15 for every round in water. 1d6 cold damage on fail, half on success. 
Players still on ice can move. 5ft is DC15 acrobatics or survival. 10 ft is DC20, and so on.
Ice within 15-20 ft of original hole breaks after 3 rounds, and other holes created also break. 
To get out of ice, athletics or survival check DC15. If fail, ice in that square breaks.
They can swim under the ice to other side
Can hold breath for a number of rounds equal to con score
Characters who fell in take 1d6 cold dmg (or half on successful save) every min until dry

There’s an abandoned farmhouse. Goal is to get them to long rest there. In the farmhouse are some candles (easy to find) some money (medium to find) a page from the Torah (Hard to find) necklace of prayer beads (rosary type, nearly impossible to find). 

Torah page: 
The first page. But it’s ripped at the 7th day or crossed out or smth. In Hebrew. DC 15 religion check to know what it is. DC 20 for fionnach and stryge.
Trying to imply that whoever lived in this house knew the truth about the creation story and was maybe killed. +5 to dc to know what is crossed out. -5 to dc to know what it is from.

Rosary: 
3 magic beads 
Arcana checks. DC10 - know it is magical. DC20 - Know the type of spell. DC25 - Know a bit more about spell. DC30 - Know spell fully.
Each bead contains a spell you can cast as a bonus action 
Alarm. Abjuration. Will set off an audible alarm for 10 seconds.
Darkness. Evocation. 15 ft radius magical darkness. 5 min duration. 
Stinking cloud. Conjuration. 20 ft sphere of smelly. 1 min. Each creature that is completely within the cloud at the start of its turn must make a Constitution saving throw against poison. On a failed save, the creature spends its action that turn retching and reeling. Creatures that don’t need to breathe or are immune to poison automatically succeed on this saving throw.

If they dont find this here I will add it later as well. 

During long rest, some may dream. 
STRYGE: Raw wisdom check. DC20 to reveal next line in cryptic message. 
ERASMUS: Dreams of Wrath. 
“Wrath appears in your mind's eye for just a few moments. He reaches out as if to touch your cheek, but doesn’t make contact. You feel the heat radiating from his hand. His fingers hover there for a moment, then he drops his arm slowly. He says, “I cannot visit you as usual. Someone would notice. You did very good today. The soul of a Bishop… a rare gift. It will remain with you until I can visit and collect it.” And then you are asleep.” 
ERASMUS MAY HAVE SOME OF THE BISHOPS KNOWLEDGE / VOICE IN HIS HEAD OCCASIONALLY OR SMTH 
	MAGDALENE: Receives a message. 
“Do not lose your way, my child. For you are surrounded by heretics and blasphemers. When we meet, you must be primed to enter the gates of Heaven.”

In the decrepit town of Lindlow: 
One main street 
Plague ridden 
There is a butcher, small church, town hall, inn / tavern. Maybe a fun snake oil salesman who sells a potion. If they buy smth from him, he gives them a part of the ritual. All placebo. Casting identify will reveal true nature. As would a NAT 20 check. 
RED - Potion of Superior Healing. Identical to, and indistinguishable from, a potion of superior healing. Upon drinking the potion you believe you have healed 8d4+8 hit points but healing has not occurred. If you are unconscious the potion has no effect. Each time you sustain damage, you can roll a wisdom saving throw (dc16) to realize you have not been healed.

CLEAR - Potion of Invisibility. Identical to, and indistinguishable from, a potion of Invisibility. Upon drinking the potion, for the next 1 hour, you believe you are invisible but you are not. If an ally directly points out that you are visible the potion has no effect. Each time you sustain damage, you can roll a wisdom saving throw (dc16) to realize you are not invisible.

YELLOW - Potion of (fire) Resistance. This potion is identical to, and indistinguishable from, a potion of the specific resistance type (e.g. fire, acid, etc). Upon drinking the potion, for the next 1 hour, you believe you are resistant to the potions damage type but you are not. Each time you sustain damage, you can roll a wisdom saving throw (dc16) to realize you are not resistant.

BLUE - Potion of Water Breathing. Identical to, and indistinguishable from, a potion of water breathing. When you take your first breath underwater you instead pull in water and immediately begin suffocating (drowning) per the rules on PHB pg 183. You must get to the surface or drop to 0 hit points at the beginning of your next turn.

GREY - Potion of Flying. Identical to, and indistinguishable from, a potion of flying. Upon drinking the potion, for the next 1 hour, you believe you can fly. Upon attempting to fly you quickly realize you can’t and you fall unless you have some other means of staying aloft.

Butcher: The butcher has been gone a long time, and the building is full of rotting meat. There is the remains of a demonic ritual. If the PCs choose to complete it, a succubus will appear for a minute. She was summoned by the butcher for freaking it lol. She will answer questions for them, but cannot fight them, bc demons cant harm mortals.
The butcher has a list of steps for the ritual. The sigils are partially drawn and there are candles. the ritual is torn 

Church: Empty. There is a dead priest, died from plague. There is a note somewhere in the room. The key to the catacombs is also there. This implies the priest locked the child in the catacombs lol. Also bit of demon ritual 

Town hall: There is a meeting happening. The priest is dead, so no miracles can happen. Everyone is freaking out. Meeting is about food supply. If PCs walk in, the meeting is halted to inquire who they are. 
Mayor: pushover 
Man: Jaded abt god 
WOman: Loves god 
Other man: Loves the woman 
Another man and woman: Do not care

Inn: Empty except the barkeep. He is a jaded old man. Markus or something. Gives them cryptic message. 
‘My son worked at the cemetery. He came running back to me just before this god forsaken plague hit my town. He said ‘papa, I found the devil’. But he wasn’t afraid, no, he had this… fire in his eyes. Like he was going to put up a fight. And I took it seriously, and I said ‘boy, what do you mean? Aint no devil in this town.’ and he said ‘but there is, in the chambers, and I’m gonna banish him.’ And I cuffed him up the head and forbade his silly fantasies. Sent him to his room to read the scripture. I shoulda listened. Boy disappeared and the next day we started getting infected.’
He also has part of the ritual. 

The graveyard: small, dead. It is snowing. Entrance to underground chambers. Rats. To enter, need key. It has a couple rooms. One of which is locked via magical means.
In one of the rooms is an injured boy. Leo. He has a magic item: A wand of some kind that can only levitate corpses. He says it was a gift but wont say from whom. He has the key to the rat room, but it wont work for some reason.
In one room is a riddle. Create that which is so fragile, to utter it's name would break it. The answer is silence. However, the torches are crackling. They must put out the light. Then the door opens.



SESSION 3

The party has to 1. Summon the siren and 2. Beat the rat king.
Leo the child has been given new job: clean out the butcher shop. 
Party finds hand mirror in inn for the ritual 
Party will probably do siren ritual I hope 
Crypt puzzle: 

3 rooms 
1 room locked 


Entry: Some torches. Riddle for door can be accessed here, inside a locked box. The box has a DC of 25. Two keys are needed- it cannot be picked unless by two people, who both must make a 15 dex check at disadvantage. The door is sealed magically.

Room 1: Mural on wall. Depicts the story of a man who was eaten by leviathan and went to hell. When torches are put out, the words ‘Gates of Hell’ subtly glow. There are some caskets. Caskets can be opened.
C1 - Nothing of use. Skeleton in priestly robes.
C2 - Full of rats that skitter away when opened. 
C3 - The corpse has a mirror placed over its face. When the casket is opened, the person who opened it is convinced the corpse has their face. Int save DC 13, they realize it is simply a mirror (Phantasmal force). The mirror is ‘Mirror of the past’. It is visibly falling apart and only has 1 use. 
C4 - Corpse holding a key to the locked box. 
C5 - A statue of a beast. Engraved on the bottom are the words ‘A gift from the Pope - Year of our Lord 5198’

Room 2: Mural on wall. Depicts the story of a half angel ascending to heaven by climbing a tower. When torches are put out, the words ‘Gates of Heaven’ subtly glow. 
Table - Some embalming tools. 
Shrine - Wooden cross, lit with candles, and the other key to the lock box. 

Room 3: Rat king fight. After the fight, players have a chance to see mural on wall. Depicts Jesus being resurrected. There are words that read ‘Pray for the second coming’ if the lights are out. There is also a note. 
‘If you are reading this, sorry about the rats. - C’
Room 3 is akin to a records room. Most of everything has been chewed up by the rats, except a map of the Vatican City that is hung on the wall. There are 3 points on the map that are circled. These circled points are relevant later at the city. 

After leaving the crypt and going back to town, the party will be greeted by the mayor who has acquired a carriage for them. 

SESSION 4

Opens in the inn. Erasmus meeting with Wrath. A little rp moment, Wrath takes the soul of the Bishop. Wrath warns that the city is a very dangerous place for someone like Erasmus. 

Magdalene and Fionnach have the plague. Not visible yet but their max HP decreases by 10 points. 

To the city!!

Party arrives. Maudlin freaks. 
They are led through the square to st peter’s basilika. NPC is part of the Holy See. His name is Constance. He is a Cardinal. 
Part of the job of the Holy See as the governing body is to assist the Pope. 
After entering the Basilika, Constance will ask the party if any of them wish to undergo confession before meeting the Pope. PCs who choose to undergo confession will be brought to a confessional booth (I will take them into my room lol). 
They will then meet the pope, who tells them that they are super late. 
He will ask about Stryge. The party must convince him to not lock Stryge up and/or kill him.
He then tells them of the quest - the source of the plague has been tracked to the mountains east of the city. They are tasked with finding it and ending the plague, which is demonic in origin and not a sign from god. 
He will give them one day in the city to prepare, but they must leave the following morning. 

Plotlines: 
Secret pagan cult 
The fox statue in the crypt is actually the old leader of this pagan cult. Perhaps the same cult that made Vixor. However the cult has since died out, Vixor was sort of the last thing they did. Their whole belief system was that animals have the same sort of souls that ppl do. And they were an active threat to the church.
They are very few in numbers, and hold residence in the Vatican city. 
They must find Vixor and remember him. 
They must try to sacrifice Fionnach by promising him that he will be reincarnated as an animal of his choosing.
Very christian world who loves Magdalene 
The majority of people in the city are very catholic. Aasimars in this world are typically either nuns or monks who are hidden from the outside world or travellers who visit towns and offer blessings. They will mistake Magdalene for a travelling Aasimar and Erasmus as her personal guard. They will respect and revere her. 
She may be asked to perform blessings 
Magdalene and Erasmus should be approached about a demonic possession. They will be asked to help with the exorcism. 

If the party goes somewhere with nothing interesting going on, one of these main quests will begin. 

CULT: See Vixor. Speak to him.
Invite him to the Necropolis, where the cult meets
Tell him not to bring his catholic friends. 
Tell him he can find entrance in the museum or monastery. The entrance in the basilika is very guarded. Recommend he comes at night.
If they go to necropolis, must find way through without getting lost. 
Once there, they will meet a few people. The remains of the cult. 
NPC spokesperson: Sexy woman. Her name is Lily. 
She will tell them about the cult. She will ask them to join. Their goal is to dismantle the catholic church from the inside. 
In order to join, each person much give a piece of valuable info to the cult. 
They are then tasked with a heist. There is a magical ring in the museums (ring of Saint Thomas Aquinas). They must steal it. 

EXORCISM: See Magdalene, speak to her. 
First it is just small tasks. 
Fix a woman’s torn coat 
Offer advice to a man who just lost his job 
Heal a sick person 
After, she will be asked to help with an exorcism in the outskirts of town. 
The exorcism is being performed on a poor farmer, farmer Baltrude. His fields are dead and he is scared and desperate. 
It is a demon of Sloth. Its name is Valgon.
Magdalene will be given script. 
After 1, priest will demand the demon’s name. After 2, priest will hand magdalene a cross and tell her to wield it. After 3, the priest will continue to demand the demon leave, until it does. The priest will assure them that a demon cannot physically harm them without a contract. 
If Erasmus is there, I will be making Con saves as Wrath, DC 15. On a fail, Erasmus must make a Wis save DC 15 or be momentarily possessed as Wrath is forced to the surface. 
They will thank Magdalene, and she will be given a ‘holy mirror’ that can reveal the past. She is warned that it can only be used once.

SIDE QUESTS: 
Churches quest: There are “important documents” floating around the chapels. When PCs enter a church or chapel, the quest will be triggered. The priest at the chapel will ask them to fetch important documents that they lent to another priest. This will send the PCs to every church. At the end, they will find that the documents have been returned to the original owner already. 
The “important documents” is actually a page or two from a smutty novel written by Constance. 
This can be used to blackmail him into letting the party in restricted areas. 

CIRCLED LOCATIONS: 
There is a way to disable the shield on the city. 
St. Peter’s Square 
The entrance to the city. Grand. Obelisk in center 
The obelisk is important. It contains some sort of power that protects the city and repels demons. Wrath will be unable to enter the city, and Erasmus will lose spells granted by Wrath. (When the rapture happens, the city will be shielded from demons)
At the very top of the obelisk is the source of the power, a gem. The gem is lodged in the obelisk, and if touched, deals 4d6 psychic damage. 
Heliport 
A large pit in the ground, thought to be a portal to hell. 
Guarded 24/7 
The gem must be thrown in here to disable its power. 
Galliaro tower 
Surveillance tower, used for perimeter control 
Looms over the gardens 
Instructions for disabling power. A pictogram drawn badly lol. 

OTHER LOCATIONS: 
St. Peter’s Basilika 
First meeting point. Where the pope holds mass and such. Party will meet pope Fornicus there. 
In the basilika are two mysterious doors. 
Holy door: Located to the far right of the building. A door sealed with brick. Only opened every 25 years by the pope during ceremony. 
This room is sort of like the Pope’s bunker for the rapture. He plans to seal himself in there once it happens.
Door of the dead: Located to the far left. Entrance to the Vatican Grottos under the Basilica, where past popes and other figures are buried. In the Grottos is an entrance to the Necropolis, an ancient underground burial area. The Necropolis is guarded and entry is not permitted, but there are other secret entrances around the city.
Inside the necropolis is the tomb of St Peter, who is the first pope. It is completely sealed, but if the party decides to open it they will find his mummified body. He is holding a very fragile scroll. The scroll just has this written on it: “EGO TE EXPECTABO MCCCI ANNIS POST” (I will wait for you 1301 years later)
The tomb is heavily guarded and they should not be able to open it easily at all. 
 < The Tomb









Apostilic Palace
The official home of the Pope (papal apartments, floor 3). Also contains offices of the Holy See (floor 2) and the Vatican Library (floor 1).
LIBRARY: Open to public. PCs may choose to go and look around the books. If they roll high enough, they will find a book that pertains to their particular character / backstory. (excerpts in printables)
OFFICES: Not open to public. PCs could be arrested if they go in there and are caught, unless Constance takes them up. In the offices there is a lot of paperwork and such. If they manage to look around, good enough, they can find some info. (Map in printables)
PAPAL APARTMENTS: Not open to public. Locked. They will be in deep trouble if caught in there. If they manage to look around, theres some money they can find. 

Barracks of the Swiss Guards 
Barracks of the Pope’s guards and knights. They live there.

St. Anne of the Palafrenieri
Church dedicated to Saint Anne. Saint Anne was the mother of Mary, grandmother of Jesus. Patron saint of unmarried women, women in labor, and grandmothers. Parish church, open to anyone.
Priest is secretly a woman 
Father Chad (real name: Chastity). Manly.
CHURCHES QUEST: Passed important documents to Father Lance at church of st Pelligrino. 

Vatican Press 
Holy See Press Office, releases a daily news bulletin. 
If they go here they can get a newspaper (printed)

Church of St. Pelligrino 
Church dedicated to Saint Peregrine of Auxerre. Patron saint of those afflicted with cancerous disease and snake bites. Serves as the chapel for the security force in the city. 
Father Lance. Twinky. Gay?
CHURCHES QUEST: Passed documents to Father Michah at the Sistine Chapel.

Barracks of Papal Gendarmes
Barracks of the police /military force for the city. 

Belvedere Palace 
The city’s pharmacy / apothecary. 
Dubious Cure for sale. 5 Gold. 

Belvedere Casino 
A casino :D
Games + Alcohol for sale

Vatican Museums 
Just so many museums. The party can peruse the items. If they roll good, they can increase their religion score by 2. If they roll great, they can increase their int score by 1. 
Within the museum is a secret entrance to the Necropolis. 
Also the statue of Eve is in here. When they see her, Stryge will make a Wis check DC 15. If he makes the roll, the statue is familiar. If he gets 20 or above, he will remember more of the message.

Borgia Tower 
A tower with 6 rooms. Room of the Sibyls, Room of the Creed, Room of the Liberal Arts, Room of the Saints, Room of Mysteries, and Room of Pontiffs. Each room is its own floor.

Sistine Chapel 
Located in the Apostilic palace. The Pope’s personal chapel, where he holds ceremonies and such. 
Father Michah. Pretentious. 
CHURCHES QUEST: Passed documents to Father Gunther at the Church of Santa Maria della Pietà. 

Palace of the Holy Office 
Branch of the Holy See. Ensures integrity of catholic teachings, promotes catholic doctrine, and deals with matters of religious discipline when the church’s rules are broken. Also censors books and ideas it deems ‘harmful’. The party may find one of these banned works in the building, but it is not open to the public so they must break in. 
Contains a vault with books that are going to be destroyed. One of which is a collection of sigils. 

Paul VI Audience Hall 
A large hall for conferences and such. Not very important. 

Church of Santa Maria della Pietà and Camposanto Teutonico
A small church and graveyard. Translated to “Our lady of mercy (Mary)” and “Teutonic cemetery”. 
Father Gunther. Sad sad man.

HERE IS HOW THE BEHEMOTH WILL WORK: 
The party will climb up the mountain and enter what can be described as an ancient ruin. It is in a clearing at the top of the mountain. The ground is flat, consisting of large marble slabs. Surrounding the clearing are pillars. Some have fallen on their sides, but most seem to scrape the heavens. In the center there is a slightly raised platform, a pavilion. The roof is domed. Carved into the floor of the pavilion is the sigil of Gluttony, and into the ceiling is thus: 

“Bihofþe summon gluttony, placæ ain  item sin representſ thy vicæ intī th' sigil. Unexceptid presenÞ musÞ dī perexcellentlī, for th' princæ demandſ moræ.”
(To summon Gluttony, place an item that represents your vice into the sigil. All present must do so, for the Prince demands more.)

The token of Gluttony is here, a stone tablet with the number 1000000000000066600000000000001
(This is Belphagor’s Prime, a palindrome prime number that contains 666 with 13 zeros on either side)

Once all items are placed in the sigil, they will be lit on fire and burned. The sky darkens as a huge creature awakens. It looms over the mountain, so large that only one of its eyes are visible, staring down into the ruin and at the players, blocking out the sky. A wall of flame erupts around the perimeter, trapping the players in the ruin. 
Everyone has their soul removed from their body and placed atop one of the pillars. There are 3 rounds. For every round, the party will fight 2 clones, made from their respective soul. The terrain will change each round.
